title: EU Withdrawal Button, EmpCo & Omnibus Store Auditor Input
description: Audit e-commerce stores via fast zero-browser HTTP for the mandatory EU Electronic Withdrawal Button (Directive 2023/2673 Art. 11a / BGB § 356a), abolished EU ODR platform links, EmpCo Directive 2024/825 greenwashing claims, and Omnibus 30-day lowest price rules.

urls.title: Target Store URLs or Bare Domains
urls.description: List of store URLs or bare domains to audit (supports full URLs like "https://shop.example.de", bare domains like "shop.example.de", or RequestList objects like [{"url": "https://shop.example.de"}]).

url.title: Single Store URL or Domain (Optional Shorthand)
url.description: Optional single store URL or bare domain convenience field for REST webhooks, Clay HTTP columns, or MCP calls.

datasetId.title: Upstream Apify Dataset ID (Optional Chaining)
datasetId.description: Optional Apify Dataset ID (e.g. from Google Maps Scraper or E-Commerce Lead Extractor) to automatically import store URLs and deduplicate with urls.

datasetUrlField.title: Dataset URL Field Override (Optional)
datasetUrlField.description: Optional column name to extract store URLs from datasetId items. When omitted, auto-detects website, url, domain, shopUrl, or storeUrl.

maxLegalPagesPerDomain.title: Max Internal Legal/Subpages per Store
maxLegalPagesPerDomain.description: Maximum number of discovered same-origin internal pages (Withdrawal, Impressum, AGB/Terms, Returns, Product/Sale) fetched per store in addition to the homepage (0-5).

includeRemediationPack.title: Generate Multilingual HTML/JS Remediation Pack
includeRemediationPack.description: Generates a ready-to-paste multilingual 2-step EU Art. 11a Electronic Withdrawal Widget (HTML/JS) + Omnibus 30-day lowest price snippet when compliance gaps are detected (+$0.01/store).

checkWithdrawalButton.title: Check EU Art. 11a Electronic Withdrawal Button
checkWithdrawalButton.description: Checks for interactive 2-step electronic contract withdrawal flows across EN/DE/FR/ES/IT/NL/PL vs. static PDFs or guest-hostile login walls (Directive (EU) 2023/2673 Art. 11a / BGB § 356a).

checkAbolishedOdrLink.title: Check Abolished EU ODR Link Trap
checkAbolishedOdrLink.description: Scans homepage, Impressum, and Terms/AGB pages for outdated links to ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr (permanently shut down July 20, 2025 under Regulation (EU) 2024/3228).

checkEmpCoGreenClaims.title: Check EU EmpCo Greenwashing Claims
checkEmpCoGreenClaims.description: Detects generic environmental claims (eco-friendly, climate neutral, klimaneutral, éco-responsable, etc.) and checks for recognized third-party certifications (EU Ecolabel, Blauer Engel, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, FSC, B Corp) under Directive (EU) 2024/825.

checkOmnibusPricing.title: Check EU Omnibus 30-Day Lowest Price
checkOmnibusPricing.description: Detects strike-through/compare-at discount indicators and checks whether 30-day lowest prior price wording is disclosed alongside discounts (Directive (EU) 2019/2161 Art. 6a).

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Checks domain /robots.txt rules before scanning and skips disallowed paths.

maxUrls.title: Max Stores Safety Cap
maxUrls.description: Hard ceiling on the total number of stores audited in a single run to prevent accidental budget overruns.

domainDelayMs.title: Per-Domain Polite Delay (ms)
domainDelayMs.description: Minimum polite delay in milliseconds between consecutive HTTP requests to the same hostname.

requestTimeoutMs.title: HTTP Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: Strict timeout per HTTP request in milliseconds (default 12000ms).
